findings.reason: The lemma permits L^- to have any column count but pads only L_R to at least p columns. The reduced QR supplier requires the prearray transpose to have at least p+n rows, so this QR may not exist when L^- has fewer than n columns (for example, L^-=0 with R positive definite). Pad L^- or the full prearray with zeros until its total width is at least p+n; this preserves the approved rank-deficient scope.

In both this Definition and the measurement-identity lemma, L is assigned as R^T and partitioned before rows of R are sign-adjusted. The stated positive-diagonal result then does not follow unless L is updated. Apply the signs before defining and partitioning L, or explicitly apply them to L's first p columns; the Gram identities are preserved.
